dafny.dependency_parser_policy: Use pinned Dafny parser adjacency output recursively, before freezing and after generation. Only the exact legacy-CLI banner is consumed; every source/parser diagnostic remains fatal. Transitive output is empty in this pinned distribution. Sources must be UTF-8 (an initial BOM is allowed); ambiguous semicolon/newline paths and repository escapes are rejected. /noResolve confines discovery to parsing; every source is subsequently resolved and verified as a root under the strict proof policy.
dafny.source_solver_case_split_reason: The native composition receipt uses Z3 default case_split=3; frozen full-root NativeMlKem verification under the kernel case_split=0 policy produced5timeouts/3resource failures. Apply3 explicitly to this composition source, retain0 for native kernels and the unchanged30s/50M/2-core limits. This is a solver-strategy selection, not a proof-domain or budget change.

dafny/DafnySequence.class.difference: toString calls Object.toString via invokevirtual in Maven instead of List.toString via invokeinterface in the bundled runtime; constant-pool owner/tag and consequent code/debug lengths differ. Other 90 classes are byte-identical.

javac.cast_lint_reason: Pinned Dafny emits redundant primitive casts. Disable that category explicitly in both Maven and canonical javac; do not rewrite generated sources or discard emitted diagnostics.
javac.rawtypes_lint_reason: Pinned Dafny emits a raw dafny.Tuple2 return type for compiled reference tuple functions (observed VerifiedPolynomial.BaseCase). Keep compiler output unchanged; disable this category explicitly in Maven and canonical javac, with every other emitted diagnostic still rejected.
javac.handwritten_lint_scope: Final acceptance separately compiles all handwritten main Java, including retained providers and facades, with original lint. New generated crypto is classified by its exact checked namespace; existing generated packet Java is classified by an exact source pin. Maven default-testCompile retains original lint for tests.
javac.package_info_reason: Emit documentation-only package-info.class files with javac in every phase. This avoids Maven synthesizing different package metadata outside the canonical compiler and permits exact comparison of every main class without ignoring metadata.

trust: Dafny 4.9.1 and Z3 4.12.1 implementation correctness; official archive bytes are checked in full before and after.
JDK javac/JVM correctness; the explicit JDK file graph is pinned before and after. Exact class equality, including all attributes, connects canonical generation to delivered Maven classes and JAR.
Maven DafnyRuntime 4.9.1 correctness, independently pinned from the bundled runtime. The different DafnySequence class is not assumed byte-identical.
JDK SHA3-256/SHA3-512 provider correctness, normal completion, input preservation and fresh fixed-length output; four audited declarations represent two primitives.
Original sequence hash adapters may be retained for generated mathematical module compilation. Their unused paths receive no native or constant-time claim.

User authorization to integrate after checks and the later evidence-based compatibility/performance adoption decision are separate policy inputs. A delegated decision records the prior user authority, agent evaluator, exact stage/source hashes and pinned evidence; passing tests or elapsed time never create authorization. JVM timing, JIT/CPU behavior, physical erasure, entropy and cryptographic hardness are not proved.
existing_generated_provenance: Exact existing packet compiler-output source pin from formal/packet/inputs.json; only this file is excluded from handwritten lint. It is separately compiled under explicit generated-code flags and its exact class bytes join final Maven class/JAR comparison.

native_evidence.receipt_format: native_kem_checks.py unversioned JSON, identified by this versioned contract and exact runner SHA256
native_evidence.drift_policy: Runner schema and inventory changes require explicit contract review/version or pin update. Every current domain dependency, runner, harness, provider and reference Java hash must match; partial controls or matching partial inventories cannot qualify. Full staging replays proofs but relies on these complete pinned controls and supported-JDK replays.

bytecode_control_rejections.selector-payload-branch: Selector payload branch or changed loop control

wide_shift_helpers.bv64ShiftRight: Only shift-distance==64 branch; first operand never tested
wide_shift_helpers.bv64ShiftLeft: Only shift-distance==64 branch; first operand never tested

fixed_fields.metadata_boundary: toInt/toIntChecked and Euclidean calls carry public lengths, indices, widths, loop counts and table offsets; BigInteger carries only fixed-size initialization indices or array lengths.
fixed_fields.scope: Native executable classes and pinned runtime helper bodies; source/bytecode discipline, not a JVM timing theorem

caller_review.NativeMlKem: ExpandMatrix divides/mods only its public k=0..8 counter. BigInteger carries fixed3/9 reference-array initialization indices or public array lengths. Select uses only literal56 for its wide shift.
caller_review.NativePolynomial: Stage, block, coefficient and twiddle-table indices control all division, table selection and allocation; coefficients enter only the verified native field operations.
caller_review.NativeKeccak/NativeShake: Rate, phase, position, input/output lengths, fixed25/5 arrays and public rotation-offset tables control metadata helpers. Payload lanes enter only bv64 shifts with public distances.
caller_review.NativeCodec/NativeSampling: Widths, grouping indices and lengths are public; component operand-stack data-flow guards check PublicDiv/PublicMod/Extract/Shift boundaries. Decode(m,1) validates secret message bits, but decoded d1/d4/d10 values are bounded by1/15/1023, so IsCanonical outcomes are constant. Only d12 validation can vary; its KEM caller parses public encoded keys. Feed validates the empty/public prefix and rejects public rho-derived matrix candidates; CBD payloads avoid those branches.
caller_review.allocation/tuple/result: TypeDescriptor allocation/fill dispatch uses public dimensions/type descriptors and fixed zero values. Tuple2 and Result constructors/getters retain references. No owned KEM call reaches IntegerRange, payload toString/hashCode or mutable metadata writes.
caller_review.boundary: Generated constructors, mutable arrays and metadata are internal; the production facade must keep them inaccessible to callers. This review is source/runtime discipline, not a JVM timing theorem.

native_runtime_guard.policy: Exact source/bytecode discipline receipt for the selector-hardened source, not a JVM timing theorem or a general taint proof. The reported complete caller inventory must match its reviewed digest; any source/helper/caller drift requires explicit contract review.
